findings.finding: Voi's own Q3 report says the employee equity incentive cost rose to EUR 5.1m (1.3) because of 'a higher company valuation following Lime's IPO, higher peer-group multiples and the strong performance in 2026', which, together with LTM adj. EBITDA up from about EUR 39m to EUR 54m and net leverage down from 1.76x to 0.94x, points to a material markup of VNV's Voi stake (USD 105.9m, 21.9% of the portfolio, valued on forward EV/EBITDA) in tomorrow's NAV.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025: Voi was marked up after a strong Voi Q3 and VNV moved -0.08% on report day (2025-10-28). Q2 2026: Voi mark flat, -1.19%. Q1 2026: Voi and BlaBlaCar written down, -5.74%. Observed report-day moves since 2024: -1.2, -5.7, -7.0, -0.1, +14.8, +1.6, +5.3, -5.7, -9.2, +7.1, -5.3 (Yahoo VNV.ST closes on Nasdaq Nordic report dates).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: VNV rose from 18.24 (2026-10-21) to 19.68 (2026-10-26), +7.9%, after Voi reported. What is not public is the size of VNV's own mark. If the market had fully priced a ~30-40% Voi markup it would show as a discount to an estimated NAV of ~38 SEK that had not widened from Q2's 53%; at 19.64 the stock sits at about a 49% discount to that estimate, so some of the markup is still unpriced. The valuation sentence sits on page 5 of Voi's PDF and appears in neither VNV's nor Voi's press summary.
findings.independence: VNV's Q2 letter said Lime would be used 'in future quarters as an important valuation benchmark for Voi' (https://attachment.news.eu.nasdaq.com/af5d054067d7bfa2b2ab3dfc601d50039). LIME closed 2026-09-30 at 28.17 against a USD 25 IPO price (Yahoo chart). Same direction, different source.

findings.finding: USD/SEK moved from 9.72 (the rate VNV used at 2026-06-30) to about 10.01 at 2026-09-30, so NAV per share in SEK rises about 3% mechanically before any revaluation, and EUR/SEK moved 11.06 -> 11.34 for the EUR-based holdings.

findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q4 2025 and Q1 2026: BlaBlaCar written down on peer multiples; report days -7.04% and -5.74%.
findings.why_not_priced: A proxy: VNV's peer sets are not disclosed name by name, and BlaBlaCar was 'tracking well ahead of budget' at Q2, which pushes forward revenue the other way. Small, and in the opposite direction to the run-up.
findings.independence: Q2 report: the BlaBlaCar mark is a forward EV/Revenue model at 4.2x and the business is 'tracking well ahead of budget on both revenue and EBITDA' (https://attachment.news.eu.nasdaq.com/af5d054067d7bfa2b2ab3dfc601d50039). That cuts against this finding.

findings.finding: Lime (LIME), the listed peer VNV said it would use to benchmark Voi, has fallen from 28.17 at quarter-end to 24.60 on 2026-10-26 (-12.7%). That does not touch the 2026-09-30 mark, but it lets the market discount a Voi markup as already stale.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: none: Lime has been listed only since 2026-07-01.
findings.why_not_priced: Public, but VNV rose while Lime fell in the same days, so the market has not visibly marked the Voi read-through down. It becomes salient only when the report puts a Voi value next to the Lime multiple.
